summary: Iteration 14 testing complete. All tenant isolation and live ticket features verified. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working - Live tab shows public sessions with Buy Ticket flow, Admin panel with 5 sub-tabs (Stats, Broadcast, Live, Paid Posts, Users), phone login skip works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Tenant isolation implemented correctly - tenant_query() adds tenant_id filter to queries
Admin stats API returns tenant-scoped data (total_subscribers, active_subscribers, pending_payments, total_revenue)
GET /api/miniapp/admin/tenant/{tg_id} returns tenant info with tenant_id, name, status
GET /api/miniapp/live-sessions/public returns active/scheduled/live sessions (no auth required)
GET /api/miniapp/live-ticket/status/{tg_id}/{session_id} returns ticket status (has_ticket, status, ticket_id)
POST /api/miniapp/live-ticket/upload-screenshot accepts file upload with AI verification
Live sessions created via admin include tenant_id from admin's tenant
Non-admin users (tg_id=9999999) correctly get 403 on admin endpoints
Phone login skip button works correctly - user can bypass phone registration
seed_data_creation: Created test live session during testing (cleaned up after)
